description: Item 17: exact-mode validation (Results \S3.1) repeated on real bpRNA sequences instead of random ones, to check the random-sequence E1 result (benchmark/results/e1_random_2026-09-16) is not an artifact of uniform-composition synthetic sequences. 300 bpRNA-1m(90) sequences with length in [100,105]nt (sampled with random.seed(42) from 1,193 candidates in that range), same methodology as e1_random_2026-09-16 (beam=0, loop caps effectively unbounded, exact log-sum-exp, no profile normalization).

input.selection: 300 of 1,193 sequences with 95<=length<=105nt from benchmark/data/bprna_100_1000_list.txt, sampled with Python random.seed(42); actual length range observed 100-105nt

comparison_to_random_sequence_e1.note: Same order of magnitude as the random-sequence validation (this one is even slightly lower); confirms the exact-mode agreement is not an artifact of uniform-composition synthetic sequences.
